description: This file is a Java class named ConfigManager responsible for centralized management of configuration properties in a Selenium test suite. It loads properties from a config.properties file, supports retrieval of configuration values with precedence (system properties, environment variables, properties file, defaults), and provides specific getters for URLs, timeouts, and credentials.

classes.name: ConfigManager
classes.description: A final utility class providing centralized configuration management for Selenium test setup, loading properties from config.properties, and offering static methods to retrieve various configuration settings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key with fallback to a default value, checking system properties, environment variables, properties file, and finally using the default.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overloaded method that retrieves a configuration value by key, returning empty string if not found.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the application under test, preferring system property 'baseUrl' if set, otherwise fallback to 'base.url' property or a default URL.

methods.name: isHeadless
methods.description: Returns whether headless browser mode is enabled, based on system property 'headless' or default configuration.

methods.name: getExplicitWait
methods.description: Returns the explicit wait timeout in seconds, with a default of 15.

methods.name: getPageLoadTimeout
methods.description: Returns the page load timeout in seconds, defaulting to 30.

methods.name: getAdminUsername
methods.description: Returns the admin username for login, default 'Admin'.
